tasks.title: build P02a
tasks.prompt: Make a ring by revolving: sketch a rectangle on the XZ plane from x = 20 to 30 and z = 0 to 40, and revolve it a full turn about the Z axis. The ring must sit above the XY plane (z 0 to 40).
tasks.why_wrong: the XZ sketch's up points to -Z, so the ring sits below the XY plane

tasks.title: build P04a
tasks.prompt: Make a block 20 mm along X, 30 mm along Y and 10 mm tall, centred on the origin in XY and standing on the XY plane (x -10 to 10, y -15 to 15, z 0 to 10), and round the vertical edge at x = +10, y = +15 with a 2 mm fillet.
tasks.why_wrong: a 2 mm chamfer instead of the R2 fillet (volume within 0.3%)

tasks.title: build S04a
tasks.prompt: Set up sheet metal with thickness 2 mm, bend radius 1 mm, K-factor 0.44, round corner relief 4 mm across, and a 0.5 mm gap where flanges meet. Make a sheet metal face from the rectangle x 0 to 100, y 0 to 60 on XY, thickness up, with a 20 mm flange going up on the edge at y = 60. Add a single hem on the flange's free top edge, folded back toward -Y, with a 0.5 mm inner bend radius and a length of 5.5 mm measured to the outer face. The hem command calls the inner radius its gap.
tasks.why_wrong: inner radius 1 mm instead of the requested 0.5 mm

tasks.title: edit E01a -> E01c
tasks.prompt: Change the extrude to two sides: 10 mm up and 4 mm down.
tasks.why_wrong: 4 up and 10 down instead of 10 up and 4 down

tasks.title: edit X02a -> X02b
tasks.prompt: Edit the extrude so it takes only the inner disc instead of the ring.
tasks.why_wrong: the right shape, but deleted and rebuilt instead of editing the extrude

tasks.title: edit P04a -> P04c
tasks.prompt: Add the vertical edge at x = -10, y = +15 to the existing fillet, so both +Y vertical edges are rounded R2 by the same feature.
tasks.why_wrong: the second edge rounded by a new fillet, not added to the existing one
